::: {#exm-konigsberg-matrix}
#### Counting parallel edges

With its vertices in the order $A, B, C, D$,
the bridge graph of @exm-konigsberg has the adjacency matrix (@def-adjacency-matrix)

$$
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & 2 & 2 & 1
\\
2 & 0 & 0 & 1
\\
2 & 0 & 0 & 1
\\
1 & 1 & 1 & 0
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

The entries 2 count the two parallel edges (@def-parallel-edges) between $A$ and $B$ and the two between $A$ and $C$.

:::
